description: Rank 1 Moon Path Gu. The signature relic of the Gu Yue clan. Consumes primeval essence to release razor-sharp cyan curved crescent moonblades from the palm.
Rank 1 Light Path auxiliary Gu. Emits a warm speck of light that can illuminate dark grottos or be infused into offensive Gu to amplify radiance and projectile velocity.
Rank 2 Moon Path Gu. Refined by merging Moonlight Gu with Little Light Gu. Fires eerie, elongated moonbeams with significantly heightened piercing power.
Rank 2 Moon Path Gu. Produces curved moonblades that inflict persistent festering lacerations, slowing wound closure and causing blood leakage.
Rank 3 Moon Path Gu. Integrates metal brilliance into lunar blade resonance, producing shimmering golden arcs capable of slicing through granite fortifications.
Rank 3 Demonic Moon/Blood Path Gu. Swallows fresh blood to launch crimson lunar discs that carve flesh and siphons vitality to accelerate flight duration.
Rank 1 Strength Path body modification Gu. Consumes essence over time to continuously rebuild the mortal host's marrow and muscles, engraving the permanent strength of one boar.
Rank 1 Strength Path body modification Gu. Permanently confers the physical strength of one black boar once fully integrated through prolonged nourishment and marrow tempering.
Rank 2 Strength Path Gu. Hardens muscle fibers to an iron-like density while permanently bestowing an additional layer of brutal boar charging force.
Rank 2 Strength Path Gu. Imprints the towering muscular foundation of a feral mountain bear directly onto human anatomy.
Rank 3 Ancient Strength Path Gu. Engraves permanent brown bear strength dao marks onto skeleton and flesh, allowing mortal hands to overturn boulders without essence expenditure.
Rank 1 Defense Gu. Bestows a dull bronze luster across the body surface, granting resistance against blunt impacts and shallow iron blades.
Rank 1 Defense Gu. Coats the host epidermis in spotless white jade luster, deflecting standard Rank 1 moonblades and mortal weapon cuts with minimal essence consumption.
Rank 2 Defense Gu. Upgrades the epidermal layer into dense white nephrite jade, capable of absorbing physical kinetic concussions and magical element splashes.
Rank 2 Bone Path Gu. Penetrates into deep skeletal tissue, converting calcium bone into solid dark iron to withstand bone-shattering force.
Rank 3 Peak Defense Gu. Envelops the Gu Master in an ethereal glowing white mantle of celestial armor, completely dissipating Rank 1-2 strikes and mitigating Rank 3 attacks.
Rank 1 Recon/Concealment Gu. Manifests translucent fish scales across the skin, obscuring body heat and auditory presence in rivers or damp marshlands.
Rank 2 Recon Gu. Renders the user near-invisible to mortal vision and Rank 1 olfactory and auditory inspection as long as motion remains measured.
Rank 3 Recon Gu. Allows the Gu Master to completely merge into aquatic currents like an incorporeal phantom, suppressing essence leakage and acoustic ripples.
Rank 1 Wood Path Movement Gu. Rooted into the soles of the boots or feet, spring coils release rapid kinetic bursts for vertical launches and tactical evasions.
Rank 2 Movement Gu. Coils elastic green energy beneath the host limbs to execute consecutive mid-air ricochets and rapid tactical repositioning.
Rank 2 Wind Path Movement Gu. Summons miniature air currents swirling around the feet, accelerating sprint velocity and negating terrain friction.
Rank 3 Movement Gu. Ignites electrical spark trajectories underfoot, granting blistering horizontal sprint bursts equivalent to flash lightning across the battlefield.
Rank 1 Water Path Healing Gu. Exudes clean restorative nectar to detoxify weak poisons and quench fatigue, rapidly replenishing physiological stamina.
Rank 2 Wood Path Healing Gu. Emits vitality-rich emerald mist over flesh wounds to halt severe bleeding and mend torn muscle fibers within seconds.
Rank 2 Strategic Flora Gu. Rooted inside the primeval sea, it sprouts up to nine emerald vitality leaves that can be plucked and consumed directly for instant wound regeneration.
Rank 3 Rare Wood Path Gu. Channels surging restorative bio-vitality capable of knitting shattered bone fractures, repairing ruptured organs, and restoring near-fatal trauma.
Rank 1 Olfactory Recon Gu. Secretes invisible aromatic markers on targets to trace footsteps, beast packs, and hidden trails over several li.
Rank 1 Qi Path Gu. Subdues the biological and spiritual aura of the Gu Master, disguising aperture cultivation stage from hostile inspection.
Rank 2 Earth Path Symbiotic Recon Gu. Replaces one natural human ear with flesh root tendrils that burrow into the soil to detect underground movements and footsteps hundreds of paces away.
Rank 3 Advanced Recon Gu. Deepens somatic acoustic resonance to map subterranean tunnels, hollow caverns, hidden ore veins, and troop troop distributions over several miles.
Rank 1 Wood/Space Storage Gu. Buds as a lantern-like crimson flower on host skin, yielding an internal dimensional pocket of roughly one cubic meter for inanimate cargo.
Rank 2 Storage Gu. Expands spatial holding capacity to ten cubic meters, with minor mass dampening to allow effortless transport of provisions, ores, and weapons.
Rank 1 Legendary Food Path Support Gu. Ingests crude primeval essence from the host aperture and regurgitates it refined by one sub-stage, effectively doubling combat output efficiency.
Rank 2 Support Gu. Requires spicy, sweet, sour, and bitter vintages to refine. Purifies Rank 2 Red Iron primeval essence up to a higher sub-stage.
Rank 3 Sublime Food Path Gu. Purifies White Silver primeval essence, allowing Rank 3 Gu Masters to wield Upper or Peak stage combat intensity prematurely.
Rank 4 Time Path Gu. Consuming this legendary Gu permanently extends mortal lifespan by 10 years.
Rank 5 Time Path Gu. A divine treasure of heaven and earth. Consuming this Gu permanently extends mortal lifespan by 20 years.
Rank 4 Time Path Gu. The pupal slumbering stage of the legendary Spring Autumn Cicada, drinking the mystic water of the River of Time.
Rank 5 Time Path Gu. Fang Yuan's signature vital Gu, capable of carrying will and consciousness back into the past upstream the River of Time.
Rank 4 Time Path Gu. Accelerates aperture time flow and technique recovery.
Rank 4 Time Path Gu. Fires arrows woven from temporal essence that age enemy shields and flesh.
Rank 4 Time Path Gu. Harnesses diurnal temporal cycles to invigorate spirit and will.
Rank 4 Time Path Gu. Accumulates month-phase cycles to refine temporal primeval essence.
Rank 5 Time Path Gu. Commands annual river fluctuations, enabling grand temporal killer moves.
Rank 4 Strength Path Gu. Bestows the crushing defensive mass of an ancient iron bear.
Rank 4 Strength Path Gu. Imbues boundless boar strength permanently into bones and muscles.
Rank 4 Strength Path Gu. Surges strength momentum like a carp leaping over the Dragon Gate.
Rank 4 Strength Path Gu. The supreme cornerstone of strength path, manifesting beast phantoms at will with 100% reliability.
Rank 4 Strength Path Gu. Strikes with the apex ferocity and tearing power of a mountain overlord tiger.
Rank 5 Strength Path Gu. Engraves the permanent might of a primordial giant bear directly into the cultivator's physical physique.
Rank 5 Strength Path Gu. Wields gargantuan brute force capable of uprooting rocky mountain ranges.
Rank 4 Moon Path Gu. Shrouds the cultivator in a translucent robe of pale moonlight that deflects blade and talisman arts.
Rank 4 Moon Path Gu. Blends the cultivator's silhouette into moonlight, flickering across space like an ethereal phantom.
Rank 4 Moon Path Gu. Unsheathes frigid silver crescent blades that freeze wounds upon impact.
Rank 5 Moon Path Gu. Unleashes immense curved beams of pure moonlight with devastating cleaving force.
Rank 5 Moon Path Gu. Generates a freezing crystalline dome of moonlit rime that blunts enemy attacks.
Rank 4 Blood Path Gu. Releases an eerie crimson wail that ruptures enemy blood vessels and drains life essence.
Rank 4 Blood Path Gu. Coagulates spilled blood to mend grievous aperture and organ wounds rapidly.
Rank 4 Blood Path Gu. Ancient demonic inheritance relic created by Blood Sea Ancestor to purify bloodlines.
Rank 4 Blood Path Gu. Sprouts crimson blood wings from the cultivator's back for high-speed aerial flight.
Rank 5 Blood Path Gu. Incites frenzied blood surges in surrounding foes, causing sudden hemoptysis and heart ruptures.
Rank 5 Blood Path Gu. Summons a torrential wave of caustic crimson blood that submerges the battlefield.
Rank 5 Blood Path Gu. Legendary relic inherited from the Blood Sea, commanding blood essence with sovereign authority.
Rank 4 Bone Path Gu. Ejects calcified white bone javelins from palms that pierce through heavy armor.
Rank 5 Bone Path Gu. Manifests a majestic ivory battle chariot providing fortress-grade defense and crushing ramming power.
Rank 4 Bone Path Gu. Unfurls segmented bone wings grafted onto the shoulder blades for high-speed evasion.
Rank 4 Bone Path Gu. Fires deadly volleys of barbed calcified bone quills.
Rank 4 Bone Path Gu. Coats the cultivator's skin in an impenetrable layer of interlocking ivory ribplates.
Rank 5 Bone Path Gu. Conjures a colossal tower shield forged from ancient dragon rib bone.
Rank 4 Enslavement Path Gu. Imposes master-servant soul brands over myriad beast kings.
Rank 5 Enslavement Path Gu. Dominates entire mutant beast armies with sovereign soul pressure.
Rank 4 Enslavement Path Gu. Chains the wills of ferocious northern wolf commanders.
Rank 5 Enslavement Path Gu. Sovereign command over countless wolf packs across entire plains.
Rank 5 Enslavement Path Gu. Commander token rallying all wild beasts under one unified will.
Rank 4 Light Path Gu. Emits searing beams of radiant light that pierce spiritual illusions.
Rank 5 Light Path Gu. Fires seven-colored prismatic rays that dissolve enemy matter and essence.
Rank 4 Wood Path Gu. Causes iron-hard ancient roots to encase the body in protective living armor.
Rank 5 Wood Path Gu. Channels endless vital sap to restore wounds and nourish the aperture.
Rank 4 Earth Path Gu. Raises thick subterranean stone ramparts to block enemy bombardments.
Rank 5 Earth Path Gu. Commands living golden soil that regenerates barriers indefinitely under earth vein presence.
Rank 4 Wind Path Gu. Unleashes tempestuous blades of gale-force astral wind.
Rank 5 Wind Path Gu. Summons heavenly astral cyclones that shred enemy flesh to ribbons.
Rank 5 Space Path Gu. The mortal embryonic form of the legendary Fixed Immortal Travel, teleporting across vast coordinates in a blink.
Rank 5 Food Path Gu. The ultimate distillation of the Liquor Worm lineage, purifying primeval essence to crystal clarity.
